validation: All three node files passed tools/validate_battle_spec.py without warnings.
simulator_fix: perf_tests/simulate_combat.py now gives node enemies_def priority over the global enemy catalog and applies per-instance stats. Before this fix, inline-only nodes produced false 100% wins in one round with zero cards, movement, and enemy actions.
balance_audit: tools/balance_audit.py --report <temporary path> exited 0 after the XP change: 25 registered enemies (0 tier deviations), 19 nodes (1 budget/band warning), XP monotonicity 0. The warning belongs to existing enc_elite_hunt, not these nodes.
interpretation: 100% wins in some 30-seed groups reflect low-stakes story tuning and deterministic heuristic teams; they are not empty-field wins. Every final group has enemy actions and nonzero card/movement AP. Median rounds and movement AP show navigation and two-wave pacing. No live player UX run was performed.

enc_grey_checkpoint.intent: 两名路障兵守闸；T0 教学，允许撤出。

enc_grey_warehouse.intent: 隔墙和货箱使双方绕行；三名守卫，T1 取证战。

enc_grey_bridge.intent: 两波各两人；前波护卫、后波路障兵，T1 普通终局。

runtime_integration: The source repository includes four registered enemy Markdown files referenced by all three nodes. CombatSession.start smoke test spawned 2, 3, and 2 first-wave enemies respectively; bridge retained one pending wave; escape was enabled. Standalone import of a node with only enemies_def remains unsupported by CombatSession.start because it does not merge node.enemies_def. This production limitation was not changed.
regression: After setting checkpoint max_rounds to 6 and registered enemy XP to 10 for minion / 16 for standard, 33 focused pytest cases passed across perf_tests/test_combat_data_v1.py, tests/test_combat_golden.py, and tests/test_simulate_inline_enemies.py. The golden baseline only added the three new node keys; no existing snapshot changed. Six standard CLI simulations (30 seeds each) passed their thresholds.
